ASI Denies Order to Close Jantar Mantar Heritage Site

Sources have stated that the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) did not issue any order to close the Jantar Mantar heritage site on October 10. Separately, a video circulating online has been clarified to not show Hindu organizations reaching Jantar Mantar around October 10.
